FN-u12-root-preinstall-runs-after-reify. npm 11.6.2 lib/commands/install.js runs arb.reify at line 150 and the root preinstall at lines 153-163; lib/commands/ci.js removes node_modules contents at 86-98, reifies at 100, runs preinstall at 106. A preinstall hook therefore cannot stop npm pruning the root node_modules through a junction (npm/cli#3669). Recommended successor: drop the preinstall line, ship the guard CLI as a worktree-setup check, set npm_config_dry_run=true in every worker launch.

changed: The manifest refusal reason word is manifest-root-mismatch (this charter's word) where the parked module said manifest-outside-cwd. Same rule, renamed to the word the unit's contract names.

The manifest is read and parsed rather than only realpath'd, so that a missing or unparseable manifest is a refusal with its own reason word manifest-unreadable instead of falling into the generic inspection-error catch.

node_modules is tested with lstat first (isSymbolicLink) and the real-path comparison second, so a dangling link is a refusal rather than a realpath throw, and a reparse point that redirects is caught even where lstat does not report a symbolic link.

design.module: scripts/qc/guard-node-modules-link.mjs. export function inspectInstallTarget({ cwd, manifestPath }) returns { verdict: 'ALLOW' } or { verdict: 'REFUSE', reason, expectedPath, actualPath }. Rules, in order: (1) node_modules under cwd absent -> fall through; (2) lstat(node_modules).isSymbolicLink() -> REFUSE node-modules-is-link; (3) realpath(node_modules) !== join(realpath(cwd), 'node_modules') -> REFUSE node-modules-is-link (a reparse point that redirects without lstat calling it a link); (4) the manifest cannot be read or JSON-parsed -> REFUSE manifest-unreadable; (5) dirname(realpath(manifestPath)) !== realpath(cwd) -> REFUSE manifest-root-mismatch; otherwise ALLOW. main() prints INSTALL_ALLOWED with exit 0 or INSTALL_REFUSED <reason> <JSON paths> with exit 1, wraps everything in a fail-closed catch printing INSTALL_REFUSED inspection-error, and is invoked only when process.argv[1] resolves to this module.

risksForTheParent: The loop convention that names this CLI - every lane charter and the worktree-setup step calling qc:guard-node-modules-link before any npm command - is the parent's WORKERS.md / GOAL.md docs change, not this unit's. U12b ships the CLI and nothing that calls it, so on merge nothing in the repository invokes it yet.
The parked draft PR #1809 is closed by the parent when U12b merges; its module and pin are carried over by content, not by branch, so the two heads share no commit.

Directory symlinks cannot be created on this machine without elevation (measured: EPERM for every fs.symlinkSync type and 'Administrator privilege required' from PowerShell). The pin's symlink case therefore plants a junction on win32 and a real symlink on POSIX, which is the same fixture convention scripts/__tests__/preserve-run-logs.test.ts already uses; the symlink branch is proven by POSIX CI, not by this machine.
lint:units sits exactly at its ratchet (100/100), so a single new lint finding in the two added files fails that gate. The scripts path allows no-console; nothing else is relaxed.
This CLI does not prevent npm from pruning. It is a check a caller runs BEFORE npm; npm itself is unchanged. FN-u12-root-preinstall-runs-after-reify stands.
TypeScript excludes scripts/**/* and the root oxlint config ignores **/scripts/**, so tsc and plain oxlint are vacuous for the module; the focused jest pin and lint:units are the real gates for it.
